system.name: C3G
system.one_liner: Feed-forward framework that learns compact 3D Gaussians from unposed multi-view images with learnable queries and lifts 2D features onto them.

content.variant_note: a teaser of three rounded tiles: a pipeline tile, an applications strip of sample renders, and a tall column of mini charts with headline numbers
content.argues: A compact set of about 2K Gaussians, 65 times fewer than LSM, is enough for novel view synthesis and for lifting features to many downstream 3D tasks.
content.subject: A Gaussian decoding pipeline, four applications on one bedroom scene, and charts comparing C3G with LSM and CF3.

lessons.what_to_learn: A teaser can combine one pipeline tile, a strip of application renders on a single scene and a column of mini charts in which the proposed method is the only accent colour against grey baselines, so headline numbers such as 2K Gaussians and 4.1 MB read at a glance.
lessons.suits: Method papers whose selling points are an efficient representation, several downstream tasks and a few headline metrics, all shown together in a teaser.

evidence: Our method learns compact 3D Gaussians from unposed multi-view images through a query-based Gaussian decoding pipeline.
Compact representations enable efficient 2D-to-3D feature lifting for downstream applications, including 3D understanding, correspondence, and upsampling.
Our C3G results in the fewest Gaussians—about 2K, which is roughly 65× fewer than LSM [10]

summary: C3G is a feed-forward framework that learns compact 3D Gaussians from unposed multi-view images and lifts 2D features onto them. Figure 1 is a teaser made of three rounded tiles. The top-left tile draws the pipeline: bedroom photos, a Gaussian Decoder fed by a row of Gaussian queries, a dashed outline around the resulting coloured Gaussians and their render, a 2D Feature Encoder and a Feature Decoder, ending in a heavily framed feature-field render. The bottom-left tile, Applications, shows novel views, segmentation with a class legend, correspondence lines and low- against high-resolution feature maps of the same room. The right tile stacks mini charts that set teal C3G against grey LSM and CF3: memory, Gaussian count (131K, 53K, 2K), PSNR, mIoU and a PCK line chart.
summary_zh: C3G 从无位姿多视图图像前馈学习紧凑3D高斯，并把2D特征提升其上。图1是三块圆角拼贴：左上为流程（高斯查询、解码器、特征编解码器），左下为同一房间的四类应用渲染，右侧以青色突出C3G的内存、高斯数、PSNR、mIoU和PCK图表。
notes: No paragraph of the paper text mentions the figure, so the roles of the four coloured squares and of the dashed outline are read from the picture and the caption only. The primary kind is changed from the prior stage-pipeline to contribution-mosaic (bento-highlights) because the pipeline covers only about a third of the area; stage-pipeline and model-anatomy stay as the kinds of the first tile. The right tile has three blocks separated by thin rules and is counted as one panel. The PCK line chart may be a bitmap; the veil over the Gaussian render is inferred from a 63% translucent white fill.
